response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as num_analyses, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind

assumptions.assumption: "analysis records" refers to rows in the advancedbehavior table; the parenthetical clarifies that if a transaction is analysed twice (two separate advancedbehavior records for the same transaction), both are counted as separate analysis records.
